zh: 按意思搜索不用再接模型：点一下，FULI 自己下个小模型在本机跑。
项目页多了「整理」：挑一个你的 AI，让它把项目读一遍，补上 FULI 还缺的。
设置重新归了类，同一件事只放一个地方；还新接了 DeepSeek Harness。
en: Search by meaning needs no model service now: one click and a small model runs on your computer.
A project page has 整理: pick an AI client; it reads the project and fills in what FULI is missing.
Settings keeps each subject in one place, and DeepSeek Harness is a client now.
